title: Manage Daily Usage Ping Data Collection Settings in Oasis
description: Learn how to manage daily usage ping data collection in Oasis browser, understand what daily usage data is, how Mozilla uses it, and how to opt out on Android, iOS and Desktop while maintaining your privacy preferences.
content:
Oasis browser, built on Firefox technology, collects separate daily usage data to help Mozilla understand how many people use it each day. This article explains what daily usage data is, how it's used, and how to opt out of daily usage data collection on Android, iOS and Desktop. Understanding these settings helps you maintain control over your privacy while using Oasis.

Privacy Note

Daily usage ping data collection is designed with privacy in mind. It only shows that you are using the browser, not what you are doing in it. You have full control over whether to participate in this data collection.

Version Requirement

This article applies to Firefox version 136 and above. Oasis users should ensure they're using an equivalent or newer version to access these settings.

What is Usage Ping Data?

The daily usage ping contains a very limited set of data, which Mozilla uses to count the number of daily active users of Firefox and Oasis. This data does not contain any information about what you are doing in the browser, it only shows that you are using it.

What Data is Collected

The daily usage ping includes:

  • Basic Usage Signal: Indicates that the browser was used on a given day
  • No Personal Information: No browsing history, searches, or personal data
  • No Content Details: No information about websites visited or content viewed
  • No User Identification: Data is aggregated and anonymous

What Data is NOT Collected

The usage ping specifically excludes:

  • Browsing History: No record of websites you visit
  • Search Queries: No information about what you search for
  • Personal Information: No names, emails, or identifying details
  • Content Details: No information about what you read or view
Technical Details

For a technical overview of the data collected in the daily usage ping, see the definitions in the Glean Dictionary for Android, iOS and Desktop.

How Does Mozilla Use This Data?

Primary Purpose

Mozilla uses daily usage ping data to:

  • Count Daily Active Users: Determine how many people use Firefox/Oasis each day
  • Support Reporting Requirements: Meet internal and external reporting needs
  • Assess Browser Reach: Understand the browser's impact and usage patterns
  • Inform Development Decisions: Guide product improvements and priorities

Mozilla's Values

This data collection is grounded in Mozilla's core values:

  • Privacy First: Minimal data collection with maximum user control
  • Transparency: Clear information about what data is collected
  • User Control: You decide whether to participate
    • Open Source: Data practices are open and auditable

Data Protection

How your data is protected:

  • Anonymous Collection: No personally identifiable information
  • Aggregated Analysis: Data is combined with other users' data
  • Secure Transmission: Data is encrypted when sent to Mozilla
  • Limited Retention: Data is not stored indefinitely
Privacy Notice

For more information on how Mozilla collects, uses and protects user data, refer to the Mozilla Privacy Notice.

How to Opt Out of Daily Usage Ping

If you prefer not to participate in daily usage ping data collection, you can opt out by adjusting your settings on Android, iOS or Desktop. For Klar on Android and iOS, the daily usage ping is opt in. Follow the steps below based on your platform:

On Desktop (Windows, Mac, Linux)

To disable daily usage ping on desktop:

  1. Open Oasis and click the Application Menu button ≡ in the upper-right corner
  2. Select Settings
  3. Go to the Privacy & Security panel, and scroll down to Firefox Data Collection and Use
  4. Uncheck the box next to Send daily usage ping to Mozilla to opt out

Note: The exact menu structure may vary slightly in Oasis, but the setting should be located in the Privacy & Security section.

On Firefox for Android

To disable daily usage ping on Android:

  1. Open Oasis and tap the menu button ⋮ on the browser toolbar
  2. Select Settings
  3. Scroll to Privacy and Security, then tap Data collection
  4. Toggle off the Daily usage ping option to opt out

On Firefox for iOS

To disable daily usage ping on iOS:

  1. Open Oasis and tap the menu button ≡ on the browser toolbar
  2. Select Settings
  3. Scroll to the Support section
  4. Toggle off the Daily Usage Ping option to opt out

On Firefox Focus and Klar for Android

To disable daily usage ping on Focus/Klar Android:

  1. Open Firefox Focus or Klar and tap the menu button ⋮ in the top-right corner
  2. Select Settings
  3. Select Privacy and Security
  4. Scroll down to the Data Choices section
  5. Toggle off the Daily usage ping option to opt out

On Firefox Focus and Klar for iOS

To disable daily usage ping on Focus/Klar iOS:

  1. Open Firefox Focus or Klar and tap the menu button ≡ at the bottom of the screen
  2. Select Settings
  3. Scroll to the Privacy section
  4. Toggle off the Daily Usage Ping option to opt out
Complete Opt-Out

To completely opt out of telemetry data collection in Firefox/Oasis, see How to opt out of data collection for comprehensive privacy settings.

What Happens When You Disable This Option?

Immediate Effects

When you disable the Daily Usage Ping setting:

  • No More Data Collection: Firefox/Oasis will stop sending daily usage pings to Mozilla
  • Privacy Enhancement: Mozilla will no longer collect information about your app's daily activity
  • No Performance Impact: Disabling this feature won't affect browser performance
    • Immediate Effect: Changes take effect immediately after saving settings

What's Not Affected

Disabling daily usage ping won't affect:

  • Other Data Collection: Crash reports or technical telemetry (managed separately)
  • Browser Functionality: All browser features continue to work normally
    • Updates: Browser updates and security patches continue
  • Sync Services: Firefox Sync and other Mozilla services remain functional

Re-enabling the Feature

If you change your mind later:

  • Easy to Re-enable: Simply toggle the setting back on in the same location
    • No Data Loss: Your previous opt-out choice doesn't affect future data collection
  • Immediate Effect: Data collection resumes immediately when re-enabled
  • User Control: You maintain full control over your participation

Understanding Data Collection Categories

Daily Usage Ping

What this specific setting controls:

  • Purpose: Count daily active users
  • Frequency: Once per day when browser is used
    • Data Type: Basic usage signal only
  • Privacy Level: Minimal data collection

Other Data Collection

Separate settings you can also control:

  • Crash Reports: Send crash data to help fix bugs
  • Technical Telemetry: Performance and compatibility data
    • Interaction Data: How you use browser features
  • Studies: Participate in browser experiments
Granular Control

Each type of data collection can be controlled independently. You can disable daily usage ping while keeping other helpful features enabled, giving you fine-grained control over your privacy.

Privacy Best Practices

Review Your Settings Regularly

Maintain control over your privacy:

  • Periodic Reviews: Check your data collection settings monthly
  • Stay Informed: Read privacy notices and updates
  • Understand Changes: Know what new features might collect data
    • User Control: Remember you can change settings anytime

Balanced Approach

Consider the benefits and privacy implications:

  • Help Improve Browser: Data helps Mozilla make Firefox/Oasis better
    • Privacy Protection: Only minimal, anonymous data is collected
  • User Choice: You decide what level of participation works for you
  • Transparency: Mozilla is open about data practices

Additional Privacy Measures

Beyond data collection settings:

  • Private Browsing: Use private mode for sensitive browsing
    • Clear Data Regularly: Clear cookies and browsing data periodically
  • Privacy Extensions: Consider privacy-focused browser extensions
  • VPN Services: Use VPN for additional privacy protection

Troubleshooting Common Issues

Setting Not Found

If you can't find the daily usage ping setting:

  1. Check Version: Ensure you're using Firefox 136+ or equivalent Oasis version
  2. Look in Privacy: The setting is always in Privacy & Security section
  3. Scroll Down: It's located in the Firefox Data Collection subsection
  4. Update Browser: Update to the latest version if needed

Setting Won't Save

If the setting doesn't persist:

  • Restart Browser: Restart Oasis after changing the setting
    • Check Permissions: Ensure the browser has permission to save settings
  • Clear Cache: Clear browser cache and cookies
  • Check Extensions: Disable conflicting extensions temporarily

Still Seeing Data Collection

If you think data is still being collected:

  • Verify Setting: Double-check that the setting is actually disabled
    • Check Other Settings: Ensure other data collection is also disabled
  • Contact Support: Reach out to Mozilla support if issues persist
  • Monitor Network: Use network monitoring tools to verify

Additional Resources

For more information about Firefox data collection and privacy settings, we recommend:

Firefox Privacy Notice - Comprehensive privacy information

Manage Firefox Data Collection - Complete data collection guide

Important Disclaimer

This guide discusses Oasis's implementation of Firefox daily usage ping data collection. The functionality and privacy practices described are specific to Oasis's approach, which is built on Firefox technology. Other browsers may have different data collection features, privacy policies, and control options.

Note: Oasis has a version derived from Firefox core, which is why it shares similar data collection features and privacy controls. The availability and functionality of these settings may vary based on your specific version of Oasis and platform.
